annotations.title: End date of an employment contract in Poland after notice

description: Use for the end date of an employment contract in Poland after notice or by mutual agreement, the notice period, the last payday, the holiday equivalent, job search days and severance pay. Give the inputs and the assumptions with the result. The result is a calculation from statutory rates. It is not advice. End of an employment contract (umowa o pracę) in Poland under the Labour Code (Kodeks pracy) when the employee or the employer gives notice, or by mutual agreement (porozumienie stron): notice period from the length of service with this employer (2 weeks, 1 month, 3 months; trial contracts 3 working days, 1 week, 2 weeks), termination date (weekly periods end on Saturday, monthly on the last day of a month; a fixed-term contract ends earlier on its own end date), last payday, pay-out date of the holiday equivalent and its amount from gross pay and unused leave days, paid days off to look for a job when the employer gives notice, severance pay in months of pay with the cap, and the employment certificate day. Facts carry the act, article, link and verification date.

by.description: Who ends the contract, default employee.

contract.description: Contract type: indefinite term, fixed term, replacement of an absent employee (fixed term), trial. Default indefinite.

contract_end.description: Fixed-term, replacement or trial contract: end date written in the contract.

employer_reasons.description: Dismissal for reasons not related to the employee by an employer with at least 20 staff (gives severance pay).

monthly_gross.description: Gross monthly pay PLN, for the holiday equivalent amount.

payday.description: Payday in the company; 1-10 pays the previous month. Default 10.

served.description: Day the notice reached the other party, or day of the agreement, YYYY-MM-DD.

start.description: First day of work for this employer, YYYY-MM-DD; include mandate or B2B work for the same employer.

trial.description: Trial contract: agreed trial length, default 3-months.

unused_leave_days.description: Unused annual leave days, for the holiday equivalent amount.
